title: 第130章 入储物戒搜寻异物第129章 接受成为共主老田获得自由
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
石泉水得到古书，也很难相信一本比手掌长度还厚的书，里面记载的都是当年发生的事情。
从书上记载来看，爆炸持续的时间整整持续了十五年。
十五年一直有爆炸，不是一次性发生了大爆炸。
如此从漫长的时间，次仙界被破坏成什么样子绝对可以想象。
甚至能怀疑如今的次仙界已经成了废墟。
连仙气都有可能变得非常稀薄。
这样的次仙界根本没有想象中的那么美好。
书中还提到了一条非常有用的线索。
在最后一天的一次爆炸过后，有东西从仙界落下，然后自行飞走了。
飞走的方向就是极北的方向。
但是不是，很难说。
“是否还有其它的书籍？”
“前辈，这是我家里收藏的，外面或许有，但可能没有这一本详细。”
石泉水将书还了回去。
书中所讲述的已经非常完整。
里面还有一些传闻。每一段传闻都会先标注是传闻。
以此来说明连书的作者都无法判断。
“主人，火纹卷内的仙界会不会就是爆炸后幸存的次仙界？”
石泉水无法断定。
即使在仙界，哪怕活了数万年，也无法走遍仙界的所有地方。

金蛇说也无法直接否定。
他只是能知道是仙界，却无法断定是次仙界还是真正的仙界。
“长老，其他分堂主都想见长老，顺便讨论冰玄之期。”
石泉水对冰玄之期没有太大兴趣，要有也只是想要得到飞升次仙界的线索。
“见我就没必要了吧？”
红姐起身将邝楠黎拉到他面前，“邝妹妹，替我招待长老，我啊还得去跟他们商谈事情。”
这话分明是话里藏话。
邝楠黎被她这一说，说的脸都红了。
石泉水倒是看见了，也明白红姐的心思，可就是直接忽视。
一个化神期修士，真要找女修，那是大把大把的送来。
“七巧，你指点邝楠黎修炼，我有重要事情处理，红姐，给我安排一个密室。”
红姐幽怨地瞪了一眼，莫名叹了一声，这让邝楠黎的脸更红了。
“长老啊，让她们陪你闭关，不是更好。”
这下连邬七巧的脸也红了。
石泉水没有废话独自走了出去，红姐则快步跟了过来。
“长老，让她们当妾室也好，反正我看她们也都是高兴的很。”
“别废话，我现在够麻烦了，不会想这种事，这地方哪里清静？”
红姐也不废话了领着去前方。
湖水也是虚假，人进入其中则是另一番天地。
“长老，此地极为清静，可放心在此地修炼，但此地没有时空之间的能力。还有一事，就是此次的冰玄之期，诸位堂主都想派人参加，之前是实力低，只敢去边缘，如今有了长老坐镇，去中央区域也可。”

“既然里面有好东西，那自然可以，若是可以，带上一些后辈也可，等我出关后再细细安排，余下的事你先负责。”
content_en:
When Shi Quanshui got the ancient book, it was hard to believe that a book that was thicker than the length of his hand recorded everything that happened that year.
Judging from the records in the book, the explosion lasted for fifteen years.
There have been explosions for fifteen years, not a big explosion all at once.
From such a long time, it is absolutely conceivable how the sub-immortal world has been destroyed.
It can even be suspected that the current sub-immortal world is in ruins.
Even the immortal energy may become very thin.
This kind of sub-immortal world is not as beautiful as imagined.
The book also mentions a very useful clue.
After an explosion on the last day, something fell from the fairy world and flew away on its own.
The direction of flight is the extreme north.
But no, it's hard to say.
"Are there any other books?"
"Senior, this is something I have collected at home. There may be some out there, but they may not be as detailed as this one."
Shi Quanshui returned the book.
What is told in the book is very complete.
There are also some rumors in it. Each piece of rumor will be marked as a rumor first.
This goes to show that even the author of the book cannot be judged.
"Master, could the immortal world in the Fire Emblem Scroll be the sub-immortal world that survived the explosion?"
The stone spring water cannot be determined.
Even in the Immortal Realm, even if you live for tens of thousands of years, you cannot visit all places in the Immortal Realm.
The golden snake theory cannot be directly denied.
He could only tell that it was the immortal world, but he couldn't tell whether it was a sub-immortal world or a real immortal world.
"Elder, the other branch leaders want to meet the elder and discuss the Ice Xuan Period."
Shi Quanshui is not very interested in the Ice Mysterious Period. If he is, he just wants to get clues to ascending to the Immortal Realm.
"There's no need to see me, right?"
Sister Hong stood up and pulled Kuang Nanli in front of him, "Sister Kuang, entertain the elders for me. I still have to discuss things with them."
These words are clearly hidden in words.
Kuang Nanli's face turned red when she said this.
Shi Quanshui saw it and understood Sister Hong's thoughts, but just ignored it.
If a cultivator in the transformation stage really wants to find female cultivators, he will send them in droves.
"Qiqiao, please guide Kuang Nanli in his cultivation. I have important matters to deal with. Sister Hong, please arrange a secret room for me."
Sister Hong glared resentfully and sighed inexplicably, which made Kuang Nanli blush even more.
"Elder, wouldn't it be better to let them accompany you in retreat?"
Even Wu Qiqiao's face turned red now.
Shi Quanshui walked out alone without any nonsense, while Sister Hong followed quickly.
"Elder, it's okay to let them be concubines. Anyway, I think they are very happy."
"Don't talk nonsense. I'm in enough trouble now that I don't think about such things. How can this place be quiet?"
Sister Hong stopped talking nonsense and led her to the front.
The lake is also false, and when people enter it, it is a completely different world.
"Elder, this place is extremely quiet. You can practice here with confidence, but there is no ability between time and space here. Another thing is that during this Ice Mystic period, all the hall leaders want to send people to participate. Before, their strength was low and they only dared to go to the edges. Now that the elders are in charge, they can also go to the central area."
"Since there are good things inside, it's okay. If it's possible, you can bring some juniors with you. I'll make detailed arrangements after I get out of seclusion. You'll be responsible for the rest first."
